jobs.title: Senior Risk Management Consultant (IRM / TPRM)
jobs.description:
Job Description:
DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world’s most complex technology estates. Learn more on dxc.com

DXC Vietnam  has been recognized as one of the " Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2025 " by HR Asia Magazine, highlighting its exceptional HR practices and 31-year legacy in the country. The company also earned the special " Most Caring Company Award" in 2025  for prioritizing employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive workplace culture.

We are seeking a Senior Risk Management Consultant to join large-scale risk transformation initiatives focused on Integrated Risk Management (IRM) and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM).
In this role, you will work closely with business leaders, risk and compliance teams, and technology stakeholders to design and implement modern risk management solutions. You will act as the bridge between business requirements and solution delivery teams, helping organizations enhance governance, strengthen risk oversight, and improve third-party risk management capabilities.
This is an excellent opportunity for professionals with strong risk management and consulting experience who are looking to contribute to complex transformation programs within the banking and financial services sector. [Senior Ris...sultant 1 | Word]

What You'll Do

Business & Stakeholder Advisory
- Facilitate workshops with business, risk, compliance, procurement, vendor management, and technology stakeholders.
- Analyze existing operational risk and third-party risk management processes, policies, controls, and governance frameworks.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and define future-state operating models.
- Gather and translate business requirements into functional specifications, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Risk & Governance Consulting
- Provide expertise across Operational Risk Management and Third-Party Risk Management domains.
- Advise stakeholders on risk taxonomy, risk and control libraries, RCSA, KRIs, risk assessments, issue management, and remediation activities.
- Support end-to-end third-party risk management processes, including due diligence, onboarding, risk assessment, monitoring, reassessment, and offboarding.
- Review risk models, questionnaires, policies, controls, and governance frameworks to align with target solution designs.

Solution Delivery & Transformation
- Collaborate with architects, developers, ServiceNow consultants, integration specialists, and project teams throughout delivery.
- Define requirements for workflows, risk scoring methodologies, assessments, reports, dashboards, and approvals.
- Support data migration activities and validate risk, control, assessment, and third-party data.
- Participate in solution demos, testing, UAT, training, and knowledge transfer activities.
- Manage requirement traceability and support project governance by identifying risks, issues, and dependencies.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Finance, Banking, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
- 7+ years of experience in risk management, governance, banking transformation, consulting, or related areas.
- Strong knowledge of Operational Risk Management and Third-Party Risk Management practices.
- Experience engaging with senior business, risk, and technology stakeholders.
- Ability to translate business processes and policies into practical functional requirements and solution designs.
- Experience with risk assessments, controls, KRIs, issue management, remediation tracking, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring activities.
- Understanding of governance, internal controls, and regulatory expectations within financial services.
- Excellent analytical, facilitation, documentation, and problem-solving capabilities.
- Strong communication skills in both Vietnamese and English.
- Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and technical delivery teams.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working for banks, financial institutions, or financial services organizations.
- Background in risk, compliance, procurement, vendor risk, or governance transformation projects.
- Exposure to ServiceNow IRM, ServiceNow TPRM, or other enterprise GRC platforms.
- Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, backlog management, and user stories.
- Experience with system integrations, data migration, testing, and business-user training.
- Professional certifications in risk management, governance, audit, compliance, or third-party risk management.

Employee Benefits and Perks
At DXC Vietnam, we follow a people‑first philosophy, offering competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support your professional growth and personal well‑being.
- Attractive and competitive salary package
- Full salary‑based contributions to Social Insurance, Health Insurance, and Unemployment Insurance in accordance with Vietnamese law
- 13th‑month salary (guaranteed)
- Generous leave policy: 12 annual leave days, 6 personal leave days, 1 volunteer leave day, plus sick leave, maternity/paternity leave, and childcare leave.
- Premium Healthcare Insurance (1+1) for employees and dependents
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential 1:1 consultation for physical and mental well‑being to support you and your family
- Access to the Well‑being Hub covering health, mental wellness, and financial planning
- Extensive resources to support your onboarding and continual development including DXC University and sponsorship for professional certification exams.
- DXC Recognition, our global virtual platform that fosters a culture of appreciation and celebration with real-time reward and recognition
- Opportunities to work on global projects, collaborate with international teams, and explore overseas assignments or relocation
- Special allowances and gifts (English/Japanese language allowance, wedding gifts, newborn gifts, etc.)
- Annual team activities and company events
- A collaborative, inclusive, and international working environment that promotes knowledge sharing and continuous growth

How to Apply & Our Commitment to You
If you would like to be part of a culture that drives innovation, delivers results, rewards performance, and encourages ideas, please click  “Apply Now”  to submit your resume.
In return, we are committed to providing a hiring experience that is transparent, fair, and engaging. Interviews and onboarding are conducted online as part of DXC’s  virtual ‑ first  approach to work.

Equal Opportunity Employer
DXC Technology is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and celebrate diversity as a source of strength. We believe in bringing your whole self to work, and our company grows only when our people grow.
Reasonable accommodation for qualified candidates may be made in accordance with the DXC Accommodation Policy, including support for individuals with physical and mental disabilities.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Director Business Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Job location: Open to anywhere within the USA

Essential Job Functions:
• Partner with clients, executive stakeholders, and internal teams to define and execute business and technology transformation strategies across the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance value chain.
• Lead modernization programs, developing transformation roadmaps, implementation plans, and business cases that align technology investments with measurable business outcomes.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by assessing current-state operations, technology landscapes, and target-state architectures to accelerate digital transformation.
• Champion the adoption of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and intelligent workflow solutions, driving innovative approaches to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.
• Provide deep expertise in P&C insurance business processes, core insurance platforms, and emerging technologies, guiding transformation initiatives from strategy through execution.
• Lead cross-functional teams consisting of business consultants, architects, technology leaders, and delivery teams to successfully execute complex transformation programs.
• Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for modernization through core system transformation, cloud adoption, low-code/no-code platforms, data modernization, and process automation.
• Develop executive-level presentations, strategic recommendations, and value realization frameworks that support investment decisions and transformation governance.
• Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies to provide strategic insights and thought leadership to clients and internal stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Insurance, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Typically 15+ years of experience in business transformation, consulting, technology modernization, or digital transformation, with significant experience in the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
• Demonstrated expertise in developing transformation strategies, business cases, operating models, and implementation roadmaps.
• Strong knowledge of P&C insurance operations, products, distribution channels, claims, underwriting, policy administration, and core insurance systems.
• Experience leading large, cross-functional teams and managing complex client engagements from strategy through execution.
• Proven ability to engage executive stakeholders and influence business and technology decisions.
• Strong understanding of AI, automation, cloud technologies, digital platforms, and low-code/no-code solutions.
• Continuous learner with a passion for emerging technologies and industry innovation.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, or related graduate degree.
• Experience with leading P&C core platforms such as Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or similar insurance solutions.
• Experience implementing AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, or digital transformation initiatives at enterprise scale.
• Industry certifications in cloud technologies, enterprise architecture, agile methodologies, or insurance disciplines.
• Proven track record of driving business value through technology modernization and organizational transformation programs.

Compensation at DXC is influenced by an array of factors, including but not limited to the experience, job-related knowledge, skills, competencies, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $139,200 - $289,000.
Full-time hires are eligible to participate in the DXC benefit program.  DXC offers a comprehensive, flexible, and competitive benefits program which includes, but is not limited to, health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; employee wellness; life and disability insurance; a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

At DXC we use the power of technology to deliver mission critical IT services that our customers need to modernize operations and drive innovation across their entire IT estate. We provide services across the Enterprise Technology Stack for business process outsourcing, analytics and engineering, applications, security, cloud, IT outsourcing and modern workplace.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Insurance Call Center
jobs.description:
Job Description:
DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

DXC's Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) helps insurers around the world modernize and run their core operations at scale by combining deep industry expertise, proven software platforms, and innovative AI-driven solutions. A global market leader in core insurance platforms, ISB delivers solutions across policy administration, claims, billing, analytics, and digital engagement supporting Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets. You’ll directly shape how the world's leading insurers operate by helping to transform the policy, underwriting, and claims systems that millions of people rely on every day.

About The Role:
We are seeking an experienced Manager, Contact Center Operations to lead day-to-day customer support center operations within a complex, multi-account delivery environment.
This role will lead teams of Associate Managers, analysts, and contact center professionals, with accountability for service-level performance, quality, productivity, customer experience, workforce utilization, and continuous improvement.
Working closely with Contact Center Operations leadership and cross-functional partners, you will translate business and client priorities into effective operational execution. You will help ensure teams consistently meet performance objectives while identifying opportunities to improve processes, leverage technology, and enhance the customer experience.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on operational leader who combines strong people leadership with analytical problem-solving and a continuous improvement mindset. You will play an important role in driving consistent execution, developing talent, and supporting the adoption of automation and AI-enabled solutions across the contact center.

What You’ll Do
Manage Operational Performance
- Lead day-to-day contact center operations and ensure performance against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, productivity targets, and customer experience objectives.
- Monitor operational performance and use data and reporting to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
- Establish clear expectations and accountability for team performance.
- Conduct regular performance reviews and implement action plans to address performance gaps.
- Ensure consistent execution of client requirements, operational procedures, and business priorities.

Lead and Develop Teams
- Directly manage Associate Managers, analysts, and/or other contact center team members.
- Coach and develop leaders to improve employee performance, engagement, and retention.
- Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
- Identify development opportunities and support talent and succession planning.
- Recognize high performance and address performance issues in a timely and effective manner.

Drive Process Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve contact center processes, workflows, quality, and productivity.
- Use root-cause analysis to identify and resolve recurring operational and customer experience issues.
- Implement process improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, and service quality.
- Share and adopt best practices across teams and delivery locations.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives using structured methodologies and data-driven approaches.

Support Workforce and Resource Optimization
- Partner with the Workforce Management Manager to align staffing and scheduling with customer demand and operational requirements.
- Monitor staffing, capacity, utilization, productivity, and service-level performance.
- Identify opportunities to improve resource utilization while maintaining customer and quality objectives.
- Support forecasting, capacity planning, and operational planning activities.

Improve Customer Experience
- Monitor customer experience metrics, quality results, feedback, and operational trends.
- Identify root causes of customer issues and implement appropriate corrective actions.
- Drive improvements in customer satisfaction, first-contact resolution, quality, and overall service experience.
- Ensure teams understand how operational performance directly impacts the customer.

Collaborate Across Teams
- Partner with Contact Center Operations leadership to execute operational priorities and account objectives.
- Work closely with Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Technology, Finance, HR, and other functional teams.
- Collaborate with client and internal stakeholders to resolve operational issues and improve service delivery.
- Support consistency and best-practice sharing across the Americas, Canada, Costa Rica, and the Philippines .
- Communicate operational performance, challenges, and improvement opportunities clearly to leadership.

Maintain Compliance & Operational Controls
- Ensure teams follow client, regulatory, contractual, and internal policies and procedures.
- Maintain strong quality and operational controls within the contact center.
- Support audits, compliance reviews, and remediation activities as required.
- Promote a culture of quality, risk awareness, and operational discipline.

What You’ll Bring
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.
- 10+ years of contact center, BPO, or BPS experience, including significant people leadership experience.
- 5+ years of experience managing contact center operations , preferably in a BPO/BPS environment.
- Demonstrated experience managing managers, team leaders, or other operational leadership roles.
- Strong understanding of contact center KPIs, including SLAs, AHT, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and service-level performance.
- Experience working in multi-channel customer support environments and with contact center technologies.
- Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills.
- Demonstrated experience implementing process improvements and driving operational performance.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting Financial Services or Life & Annuity insurance operations.
- Experience working across multiple accounts, sites, or geographic locations.
- Experience with Workforce Management and capacity planning.
- Familiarity with contact center automation, AI, analytics, and digital technologies.
- Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
- Experience working with global delivery teams.

What Success Looks Like
Operational Excellence
- Consistently meets or exceeds SLA, KPI, quality, and productivity objectives.
- Uses operational data to identify issues early and drive timely corrective action.
- Maintains strong execution and accountability across teams.

People Leadership
- Develops capable, engaged, and high-performing teams.
- Coaches managers and employees to achieve performance and development goals.
- Builds a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager (Central Government)
jobs.description:
Job Description:
At DXC Technology, we help some of the UK's most important public sector organisations solve complex challenges through technology, innovation and transformation. As government departments continue to modernise services, strengthen national resilience and improve citizen outcomes, the opportunity to make a meaningful impact has never been greater.
We're investing for growth across our UK Public Sector business and are looking for an experienced Senior Business Development Manager to drive expansion within the Home Office and wider Central Government market.
This is a unique opportunity to join one of the world's leading technology services providers and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of public service delivery through innovative technology solutions. You'll work with senior government stakeholders, influence strategic transformation programmes, and help customers address some of their most pressing challenges across digital transformation, cloud, cyber security, application modernisation, data and AI, workplace services and business process solutions.
As part of a highly successful and collaborative sales organisation, you'll be empowered to build market-leading relationships, create new opportunities and lead complex pursuits from initial engagement through to contract award. The role aligns with DXC's established Public Sector and Central Government sales capabilities and transformation focus.
Why Join DXC?
At DXC, you'll have the opportunity to work on programmes that genuinely matter.
Our teams support government organisations responsible for protecting citizens, managing national infrastructure, delivering essential public services and driving innovation across the UK. Joining DXC means becoming part of an organisation where you can influence strategic, high-value transformation programmes, collaborate with some of the most experienced sales, consulting and delivery professionals in the industry, and leverage a broad portfolio spanning cloud, cybersecurity, data, AI, applications, infrastructure and managed services.
We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We value diverse perspectives, encourage innovation and support our people through continuous learning, flexibility and career development opportunities.
The Opportunity
We're seeking a high-performing sales professional with a proven track record of building and converting strategic opportunities across the Home Office and wider Central Government landscape.
You'll be responsible for developing and executing a market strategy that identifies new growth opportunities, strengthens existing customer relationships and accelerates DXC's position as a trusted transformation partner across government.
Success in this role requires more than sales experience. We're looking for someone who understands the political, commercial and operational drivers shaping government organisations and can engage confidently with senior stakeholders to develop solutions that deliver measurable business and citizen outcomes.
You will take ownership of the full business development lifecycle, from opportunity identification and qualification through to pursuit leadership, bid strategy, commercial negotiations and contract award.
Working closely with account teams, consulting specialists, solution architects and delivery leaders, you'll help create compelling propositions that solve complex customer challenges while delivering sustainable business growth.
Key Responsibilities
- Develop and execute a business development strategy focused on the Home Office and wider Central Government sector.
- Identify, qualify and pursue strategic opportunities that align to DXC's growth objectives.
- Create and maintain a robust sales pipeline, ensuring consistent delivery against revenue and bookings targets.
- Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, influencers and stakeholders across government departments and agencies.
- Establish DXC as a strategic partner capable of delivering long-term transformation outcomes.
- Shape and lead complex technology and business transformation pursuits from inception through to contract award.
- Develop winning strategies, value propositions and customer engagement plans.
- Work collaboratively with consulting, alliance, delivery and solution teams to create innovative customer solutions.
- Contribute to account planning and growth strategies across new and existing customers.
- Represent DXC at industry events, conferences, customer forums and networking engagements.
- Maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, procurement frameworks and market trends.

What You'll Bring
We're looking for someone who combines sector expertise, commercial acumen and a passion for helping customers achieve meaningful transformation.
You'll bring:
- A demonstrable track record of winning and growing business within the Home Office and/or Central Government sector.
- Strong knowledge of UK government procurement frameworks, buying processes and commercial models.
- Experience selling complex technology, digital transformation, consulting or managed services solutions.
- The credibility and confidence to engage and influence senior executive stakeholders.
- A consultative approach with the ability to understand customer challenges and align solutions to strategic objectives.
- Strong commercial negotiation, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to work collaboratively across multiple teams and disciplines.
- A growth mindset, high levels of personal accountability and a passion for delivering results.

Experience within cloud, cyber security, AI, data, digital transformation, applications, infrastructure services or consulting environments would be highly advantageous.
Life at DXC
At DXC, we believe that great ideas come from diverse teams and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to attracting, developing and retaining talented people from all backgrounds and creating an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

DXC's Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) helps insurers around the world modernize and run their core operations at scale by combining deep industry expertise, proven software platforms, and innovative AI-driven solutions. A global market leader in core insurance platforms, ISB delivers solutions across policy administration, claims, billing, analytics, and digital engagement supporting Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets. You’ll directly shape how the world's leading insurers operate by helping to transform the policy, underwriting, and claims systems that millions of people rely on every day.

The Manager of Data Integrity & Business Intelligence is a leader responsible for driving department‑wide reporting, analytics, data governance, and operational performance. This role ensures the accuracy, reliability, and strategic use of data while directly leading a team of Operations Managers and/or Business Managers. The position partners closely with Operations, Finance, IT, and Executive Leadership to enable data‑driven decision‑making, operational excellence, and scalable performance across the BPS/BPO environment.

Key Responsibilities
Operations Management & People Leadership
- Provide direct leadership to a team of Call Center Managers and/or Business Managers, ensuring alignment to operational goals, performance standards, and enterprise priorities.

- Set clear expectations and accountability for service delivery, KPI performance, data integrity, and reporting discipline across operations teams.

- Drive operational excellence through standardized performance management, data‑driven insights, and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Partner with Operations Leadership to translate business objectives into measurable KPIs, dashboards, and management routines.

- Coach and develop managers to effectively leverage BI insights to improve productivity, quality, financial performance, and client outcomes.

- Foster a culture of accountability, data ownership, innovation, and operational rigor across teams.

- Support workforce planning, capacity management, and performance optimization through accurate and reliable reporting.

Project Management & Delivery
- Lead end‑to‑end BI, reporting, and data governance initiatives, including scope definition, timelines, budget, risk mitigation, and resource planning.

- Manage multiple concurrent initiatives using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.

- Facilitate project governance forums, executive steering committee updates, and cross‑functional stakeholder communications.

- Develop and execute roadmaps for reporting modernization, automation, and data quality initiatives.

- Identify and mitigate risks related to data accuracy, system integrations, dependencies, and operational impact.

- Ensure timely delivery of dashboards, reports, and reporting process improvements.

- Drive structured change management and adoption of reporting tools and governance standards across operations.

Power BI Development & Analytics
- Design, build, and maintain enterprise‑level Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and automated reporting solutions.

- Develop advanced data models using DAX, Power Query, SQL, and industry best‑practice schema designs.

- Deliver executive and operational dashboards with drill‑through functionality, trend analysis, and actionable insights.

- Optimize performance, refresh reliability, usability, and scalability of BI solutions.

- Establish KPI frameworks aligned to operational, financial, and strategic business objectives.

- Integrate data from SQL databases, Excel, CRM, ERP, workforce management systems, APIs, and cloud platforms.

- Investigate and resolve reporting discrepancies, data anomalies, and performance issues.

- Build, own and maintain Power BI Dashboards department wide within the Call Center delivery team, Training, WFM, and Call Center QA.

Data Integrity, Governance & Quality Assurance
- Establish, enforce, and mature department data integrity and governance standards.

- Lead reconciliation, root‑cause analysis, and audit activities to ensure reporting accuracy and trust.

- Define standardized KPI definitions, metrics, dimensions, and source‑of‑truth logic.

- Partner with IT, Operations, Finance, and Data Engineering teams to resolve data quality issues at the source.

- Maintain data lineage documentation, validation workflows, refresh controls, and exception reporting.

- Implement controls for duplicate prevention, missing data detection, transformation validation, and monitoring.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
Why We Need This Role
The account operates within a complex ISB governance environment , including:
- Formal deal governance forums (deal reviews, solution reviews) with strict submission criteria, approval thresholds, and cadence.
- Structured decision approval processes across demand, procurement, and headcount, involving multiple approval layers and stakeholders
- Requirement for traceability, compliance, and auditability of decisions and approvals across the account

Without a dedicated governance lead, there is risk of:
- Missed or delayed approvals
- Poor submission quality
- Lack of visibility and audit trail
- Inconsistent processes across teams

Key Accountabilities

1. ISB Governance Oversight (Core Accountability)
- Own and oversee governance across the account , ensuring alignment with ISB policies and processes
- Ensure full compliance with: - Deal governance (Deal Reviews, Solution Reviews)
- Demand and approval processes
- Procurement and financial governance

- Act as the single point of coordination for governance-related activities

2. Sales Governance (Deal & Solution Reviews)
- Manage and coordinate submissions into ISB governance forums , including: - Deal Review Forums
- Solution Review Forums

- Ensure: - Submissions meet required criteria, thresholds, and timelines
- Materials are complete and of high quality prior to submission

- Track outcomes, approvals, and required follow-up actions
- ISB governance forums require structured submission processes, defined thresholds, and formal approvals prior to progression

3. Governance Model & Process Ownership
- Define, implement, and maintain a clear governance model across the account , covering: - Decision approval processes
- Operations governance forums and cadence
- Submission processes and templates

- Standardise and improve governance processes to ensure: - Consistency
- Efficiency
- Transparency

4. Decision Governance & Traceability
- Ensure all decisions and approvals are: - Properly recorded
- Tracked
- Auditable

- Maintain and manage decision logs / approval trackers
- Provide visibility of decisions and status across stakeholders

👉 Current ISB processes emphasise centralised tracking and visibility of all approvals and decision outcomes

5. Business Reviews (MBR / QBR Support)
- Support monthly and quarterly business reviews
- Work with Finance and leadership to: - Produce governance-aligned reporting
- Ensure data consistency and accuracy

- Provide structured updates on: - Approvals and governance progress
- Risks and issues
- Compliance status

6. Cross-Functional Governance Coordination
- Work across: - Sales (deal governance)
- Resource Management (HC approvals)
- Procurement (P.O.s, SOWs)
- Finance (affordability, approvals, reviews)

- Ensure all areas operate within a consistent governance framework

Profile We Need

This is a control and coordination leadership role , not just admin.

Critical Skills
- Strong governance, process management, or PMO experience
- Understanding of structured approval processes and forums
- Strong ability to manage complex workflows and multiple stakeholders
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Strong communication and follow-through capability

Behavioural Attributes
- Highly structured and disciplined
- Proactive and control-oriented
- Strong accountability mindset
- Able to operate confidently with senior stakeholders
- Focused on quality, compliance, and consistency

What Success Looks Like

Near-Term
- All governance processes are: - Clearly defined
- Consistently followed
- Properly documented

- High-quality, compliant submissions into ISB governance forums
- Full visibility of approvals, decisions, and status

Longer-Term
- A fully embedded governance operating model across the account
- Improved approval timelines and reduced rework
- Strong confidence from leadership in governance and compliance

Job Description:
Job Scope/Summary
The Sales Leader is responsible for driving profitable growth for the organization by leading building, developing and guiding a team os sales professionals that produce high-impact sales initiatives, building strong client partnerships, and collaborating with technical and business experts. This role is pivotal in originating, pursuing, and closing opportunities that deliver measurable, outcome-based results for clients. The Sales Leader is recognized as a trusted advisor, bringing deep industry expertise and a strong understanding of the market landscape.  S/He serves as a principle conduit between business leadership and the sales professionals that are deployed to meet bookings targets, to include in-year revenue production.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies focused on customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth.

- Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performance sales team to consistently achieve and exceed ambitious sales targets.

- Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline, proactively adjusting strategies to meet dynamic market and client needs.

- Foster a culture of continuous learning and product expertise within the sales team, ensuring up-to-date knowledge of offerings, pricing, and competitive differentiators.

- Cultivate and expand strategic relationships with key clients, C-level stakeholders, and partners to drive business growth and long-term value.

- Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging opportunities to identify and capitalize on new business prospects.

- Champion innovation in the sales process, leveraging cutting-edge technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product development, customer support, and other business units to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions.

- Ensure accurate sales forecasting and transparent reporting to support predictable, sustainable growth.

- Provide coaching to supervised Sales Professionals around deal qualification, solution development, stakeholder engagement, competitive positioning, and close planning.

- Oversee account plans for top-tier customers, ensuring executive alignment and long-term strategic growth.

Key Deliverables & Accountabilities
- Achieve or exceed sales targets through effective forecasting, pipeline management, and execution.

- Empower and coach the sales team, monitoring performance and supporting professional development.

- Drive alignment across functions to deliver seamless client experiences and maximize business impact.

- Stay current on industry challenges, technology trends, and the evolving needs of clients.

- Maintain compliance with company policies, pricing, and licensing standards.

Requirements
Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Professional Experience:
- 12+ years of relevant work experience, with at least 4 years in a senior sales leadership role within the IT sector.

- Demonstrated success in sales strategy development, customer relationship management, and market analysis.

- Proven track record of exceeding sales quotas and driving growth in the IT market.

- Experience working in matrixed, cross-functional organizations.

Skills & Qualities:
- Strong leadership, influence, and team development skills.

- Excellent storytelling, communication, and negotiation abilities.

- Deep expertise in IT services and product sales, with a robust network of senior-level industry relationships.

- Proficiency in solution and/or insight-sales methodologies (5+ years preferred).

- Continuous learner, adaptable to evolving technologies and market conditions.

- Fluent in written and verbal English.

jobs.location: USA NY New York - 1 Rockefeller Plaza (CSC Location)
jobs.description:
Job Description:
DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) helps global companies run their mission-critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures, and ensuring security and scalability across public, private, and hybrid clouds. The world's largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deploy services across the Enterprise Technology Stack to drive new levels of performance, competitiveness, and customer experience.

Location:   New York, NY

ROLE OVERVIEW:  The deals that define careers don’t show up often. This is one of them.
DXC is looking for a Director of Sales to own enterprise CES growth across FSI not to manage a team or support a pursuit. Own it. You’ll carry the bag, build the pipeline, and close the kind of complex, multi-tower transformation engagements that most sales professionals never get near.

If you’ve spent years proving you can navigate a Fortune 500 C-suite, engineer a $25M+ win, and orchestrate a cross-functional pursuit team through a nine-month cycle — and you’re looking for the platform, brand, and portfolio to go bigger — this is the role.

WHAT YOU’RE SELLING

DXC’s Consulting & Engineering Services (CES) portfolio is built for the conversations that matter most right now. You’ll position these capabilities against the most urgent technology agendas in banking, Financial Services, Insurance, and beyond:
- Cloud migration, modernization, and cloud-native engineering

- Application development, DevSecOps, and API/integration engineering

- Data & AI platforms, analytics, and FinOps

- Core system transformation — banking, insurance, energy, telecom

- SAP and enterprise platform services (ETP)

- Security, AI/Automation, and Industry Platforms (cross-sell)

This isn’t a niche or a point solution. It’s an enterprise-scale portfolio backed by global delivery capability, and your ability to connect it to client outcomes is what wins.

WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO

Build and Own the Pipeline
- Own end-to-end new business development within assigned FSI accounts and territories.

- Generate, qualify, and mature CES opportunities through direct prospecting, executive networking, partner channels, and DXC account team collaboration.

- Consistently achieve or exceed annual quota targets of $25M–$75M+.

Lead Complex Pursuits
- Run full-cycle enterprise sales - origination through close, shaping deals before competitors know they exist.

- Lead multi-month pursuit cycles: deal shaping, solution orchestration, commercial structuring, and negotiation.

- Orchestrate architects, delivery leads, and practice leaders across time zones to build differentiated, winning proposals.

- Conduct Executive and Digital Leadership workshops and client discovery sessions to accelerate deal cycles.

Command the Room
- Establish and deepen trusted relationships with CIO, CTO, CISO, CDO, Head of Digital, and SVP Application Development within target organizations.

- Understand client challenges, legacy modernization, regulatory compliance, resilience, and cloud optimization — and align DXC solutions with precision.

- Represent DXC at industry forums, client briefings, and strategic events.

Operate with Rigor
- Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene, account planning, and accurate forecasting in Salesforce CRM — non-negotiable.

- Develop and execute strategic territory growth plans in coordination with DXC account teams and industry leads.

- Leverage Hyperscaler, SAP, and ServiceNow partner ecosystems to accelerate revenue and value creation.

WHO SUCCEEDS HERE

You don’t support deals. You close them.
You have 15+ years in enterprise IT services sales. You’ve carried and hit a $25M+ quota. You’ve closed $10M–$50M engagements, not assisted, not supported, and closed them. You know what it takes to move a deal through a regulated, risk-averse organization and get to signature.

You’re equally comfortable in a strategy session with a CIO and a whiteboard session with a solution architect. You understand how cloud modernization, application engineering, and data platforms translate to business outcomes — and you can tell that story in a language a CFO respects.

Required experience:
- 15+ years in enterprise IT services sales with FSI vertical expertise.

- Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding $25M+ annual quota in complex, consultative sales environments.

- Proven ability to lead and close $10M–$50M+ deals with multi-tower, cross-functional pursuit teams.

- Strong command of the full enterprise sales cycle: origination, qualification, solutioning, RFP/RFI, commercial negotiation, closure.

- Executive presence with demonstrated success engaging CIO, CTO, CISO, CDO, and Board-level audiences.

- Familiarity with DXC’s CES portfolio or comparable offerings: cloud, SAP/ETP, data & AI, custom app development, DevSecOps, managed services.

- Proficiency in Salesforce CRM for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.

​
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship, now or in the future

jobs.description:
Job Description:
Location: Hybrid, Columbus, OH
Summary
The Client Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for driving client satisfaction, operational excellence, and account growth within Banking Industry client engagements. The CSM serves as the primary day-to-day liaison between the client and DXC delivery teams, ensuring services are delivered successfully, contractual commitments are met, and client needs are addressed proactively.
Working closely with Client Partners, delivery leaders, project managers, and account teams, the CSM supports revenue growth, contract renewals, client retention, and overall account success. The role is accountable for key performance indicators including revenue, contract margin, operational performance, and client satisfaction while helping clients realize measurable business value from DXC solutions.
Key Responsibilities
- Own day-to-day Consulting & Engineering Services (CES) delivery activities across assigned accounts, including client satisfaction, contract performance, profitability, resourcing coordination, and service level attainment.
- Partner with delivery, project management, and account teams to ensure successful execution of project and managed service engagements while meeting quality, budget, and timeline expectations.
- Support account growth through opportunity identification, pipeline development, change requests, contract renewals, and proactive solutioning to address evolving client needs.
- Coordinate account activities across internal and client-facing stakeholders, ensuring alignment on priorities, risks, dependencies, and deliverables.
- Build trusted client relationships by understanding business objectives, identifying challenges, and helping align DXC capabilities to client outcomes.
- Support resource planning activities by partnering with delivery leadership to ensure appropriate skills and capacity are aligned to account requirements.
- Assist with financial governance activities, including revenue forecasting, contract margin performance, cash collection support, and resolution of operational issues impacting account performance.
- Partner with Project Managers and delivery teams to ensure contractual obligations are met, change controls are managed appropriately, and internal systems and reporting remain accurate.
- Act as the voice of the client within CES, advocating for client priorities and partnering with internal teams to address concerns, mitigate risks, and resolve issues in a timely manner.
- Implement and maintain account governance processes, including service reviews, KPI tracking, risk management, escalation management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Collaborate closely with sales, delivery, consulting, product, and marketing teams to identify opportunities for additional value creation and account expansion.
- Develop and maintain a strong understanding of DXC offerings, industry trends, and Banking Industry dynamics to support client conversations and solution positioning.

Financial Performance
Revenue Contract Margin Contract Renewal Performance Pipeline Development and Opportunity Management
Operational & Delivery Excellence
- Service level attainment (SLAs)
- Contract compliance

- Quality delivery and client outcomes
- Resource utilization and workforce planning
- Continuous improvement and operational efficiency

- NPS
- Client references
- Executive and stakeholder feedback

- Client retention
- Churn reduction
- Account growth support

Client Relationship Management

Business Value & Client Outcomes
Understands client objectives and helps drive measurable business impact through DXC solutions.
Account Growth & Renewals
Identifies opportunities for expansion, supports renewals, and contributes to revenue growth.
Collaboration & Influence
Works effectively across delivery, sales, consulting, and support functions to achieve business objectives.
Customer-First Mindset
Demonstrates accountability, responsiveness, and resilience while prioritizing client success.
Digital Agility & Continuous Learning
Maintains awareness of emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and industry trends to better serve clients and support DXC growth.

- Proven experience in client success, account management, service delivery, consulting, or related client-facing roles within the Banking Industry.
- Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain trusted client relationships while supporting revenue growth, renewals, and client satisfaction.
- Experience managing service delivery and complex client engagements, with a track record of delivering quality outcomes on time and within budget.
- Strong understanding of financial management concepts, including revenue forecasting, margin performance, contract management, and operational governance.
- Experience identifying and supporting account growth opportunities, including renewals, change requests, and cross-sell or upsell initiatives.
- Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities.
- Strong problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to manage risks, escalations, and client expectations effectively.
- Understanding of enterprise technology services, digital transformation, application services, cloud, data, AI, or consulting services.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

- Experience working in a global delivery environment.

- Experience supporting accounts with revenue responsibility and growth objectives.

You will lead from the front in developing new client relationships and shaping opportunities, working closely with solutioning and delivery teams to position differentiated, outcome-led propositions.

- A track record of originating pipeline and closing complex, high-value deals

jobs.title: Business Development Executive - Aerospace & Defense
jobs.description:
Job Description:
DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) helps global companies run their mission critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures, and ensuring security and scalability across public, private and hybrid clouds. The world’s largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deploy services across the Enterprise Technology Stack to drive new levels of performance, competitiveness, and customer experience. Learn more about how

Location : Remote – Washington, DC. Candidates within 25 miles of a DXC office are required to work on-site 2 days per week.

Security Clearance: Secret Preferred

Overview: As a Business Development Executive, you will be responsible for driving account growth and developing strategic opportunities with existing and new clients. Your role involves understanding customer missions, delivering solutions, and managing the end-to-end customer engagement process.

You have spent years selling Aerospace and Defense, and you want to own the market, not inherit a small slice of someone else’s territory. You want to walk into a defense prime, aerospace OEM, or supplier and be the person who opens the door, shapes the opportunity, builds the strategy, and closes the deal.

You understand how this industry buys. You know the difference between program leadership and procurement. You are comfortable with long sales cycles, complex compliance environments, and pursuits that take months and require strategy, technical understanding, and executive relationship management.
If that sounds like you, this role was built for you.

What You Will Be Accountable For
- You will own Aerospace and Defense growth. That includes pipeline, bookings, and revenue. You will build the strategy and execute it, expanding DXC’s presence across aerospace OEMs, defense primes, Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, and the broader ecosystem that supports them.

- You will lead large, complex initiatives across digital engineering, application modernization, data and AI, cloud transformation, and enterprise platforms. You will be involved from qualification through the win strategy, proposal, negotiation, and close.

- After the deal closes, you will stay engaged to ensure a smooth transition to delivery and continued account growth.

- On the Federal and Public Sector side, you will apply your experience working in regulated environments. If you have worked on IDIQs, task orders, or long-cycle pursuits, you will understand how to navigate this environment and position DXC for success.

- You will build executive relationships with clients and partners. Not surface-level relationships, but trusted relationships where clients involve you early in their planning and transformation initiatives. You will also work closely with hyperscalers, software partners, and Aerospace and Defense ecosystem partners to build differentiated solutions.

- You will maintain strong pipeline discipline, accurate forecasting, and clear win strategies aligned to DXC growth priorities.

​
What You Are Selling
You will sell large-scale digital transformation programs, including consulting, enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft Dynamics, application modernization, digital engineering, cloud and platform transformation, cybersecurity, and Data and AI solutions, supported by DXC’s global consulting, engineering, and delivery organization.

This is not a point solution sales role. This role focuses on enterprise transformation programs and multi-year-old services engagements.

What You Bring
- 10 or more years of enterprise sales experience with a strong focus on Aerospace and Defense

- Proven track record growing Aerospace and Defense accounts and closing complex multi-year services and transformation deals

- Experience selling digital engineering, cloud, data, cybersecurity, or other mission-critical technology solutions

- Strong understanding of how Aerospace and Defense organizations buy, including program structures, buying centers, capture processes, and long-cycle sales motions

- Experience working with U.S. Federal, Department of Defense, or defense-related clients

- Familiarity with regulated environments, including ITAR, export controls, and secure delivery requirements

- Experience supporting programs that require security clearances

- Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, IDIQs, GWACs, and capture methodology

- Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, technology, or equivalent experience

- Additional qualifications that are valued

- MBA, MS, or formal pursuit training such as Shipley, TAS, or Miller Heiman

- Experience working with defense primes, aerospace OEMs, or federal system integrators

- Experience leading large capture pursuits and complex proposal efforts

- Experience partnering with hyperscalers or enterprise software providers on joint pursuits

Clearance and eligibility requirements
- Active DoD Secret Clearance or eligible to be required

- Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

jobs.description:
Job Description:

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) helps global companies run their mission-critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures, and ensuring security and scalability across public, private, and hybrid clouds. The world’s largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deploy services across the Enterprise Technology Stack, driving new performance levels, competitiveness, and customer experience. Discover how we deliver excellence to our customers and colleagues at DXC.com.

Location: Hybrid. Candidates must reside within one of the preferred locations. Those located within 25 miles of a DXC office are required to work onsite two (2) days per week.
We are hiring two (2) for the following SAP regions:
- Midwest – Preference is for role to be based in Chicago or Minneapolis

- Northeast – Preference is for role to be based in New York/New Jersey or the VA/DC area.

About the Role

The Manger Sales SAP is responsible for driving the end-to-end sales process and delivering strong business outcomes by growing a profitable pipeline and sales backlog through deal origination, strategic pursuit, negotiation, and closure within an assigned region.
This role combines strategic account leadership, business development, and deep knowledge of SAP solution portfolios (ECC, S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Business Technology Platform, SAP industry cloud, and Application Managed Services). The manager leads pipeline generation, consultative selling, deal shaping, and collaboration with delivery teams to ensure successful client outcomes. The manager will also be responsible for leading a team of SAP Sales Partners as required.
The ideal candidate has strong SAP ecosystem experience, a consultative sales approach, and a proven track record selling enterprise transformation services.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the creation of solutions to complex technology business problems, leveraging deep insight into client needs.

- Develop pursuit strategies, client messaging, and executive relationships in collaboration with internal and client leadership.

- Apply leading practices in cloud transformation and SAP modernization to drive large-scale sales opportunities.

- Partner with delivery, solution, and pursuit teams to ensure cohesive sales execution and alignment to client outcomes.

- Operate within large, cross-functional teams while directing specific sales activities.

- Travel may be required based on client and business needs.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of education and experience

- 7 years of experience in sales of complex business software/IT solutions

- Proven success in business application software sales and leading team-selling environments.

- 7+ years in Sales Pursuit Management, including direct sales ownership with a minimum annual quota of $25M.

- 8+ years’ experience selling within the SAP technology ecosystem.

- Strong knowledge of workload disposition for cloud migration and modernization initiatives.

- Proven collaboration with hyperscaler partners (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

- Demonstrated ability to handle large transactions and lengthy sales campaigns in a fast-paced, competitive market.

- Strong negotiation skills and experience in renewals, expansions, and up-sells of subscription-based solutions

Preferred Skills & Experience
- Demonstrated success in C-level relationship building and executive stakeholder management.

- Ability to operate effectively in team-based environments, showing collaboration, adaptability, and resilience.

- High energy, professional integrity, and exceptional communication, leadership, and decision-making skills.

- Exceptional communication, both verbal and non-verbal.

- Strategic thinking with a high degree of creativity and innovation.

- Strong executive presence and results-driven mindset.

- Ability to work across multiple teams within a matrix organization

The candidate must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. and will not require visa sponsorship, either now or in the future.

Compensation at DXC is influenced by an array of factors, including but not limited to the experience, job-related knowledge, skills, competencies, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $120 600 - $180 800.
Full-time hires are eligible to participate in the DXC benefit program.  DXC offers a comprehensive, flexible, and competitive benefits program which includes, but is not limited to, health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; employee wellness; life and disability insurance; a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Automotive & Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Job Description:
DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) helps global companies run their mission-critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures, and ensuring security and scalability across public, private, and hybrid clouds. The world’s largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deploy services across the Enterprise Technology Stack to drive new levels of performance, competitiveness, and customer experience.

DXC Technology partners with Automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and Manufacturing enterprises to accelerate business transformation through AI-led innovation, application modernization, enterprise platforms, and digital solutions.

This is a hunter role focused on acquiring new clients, expanding executive relationships, and creating new revenue opportunities across the Automotive and Manufacturing sector. You will work with C-level executives to shape transformation strategies, develop complex services opportunities, and position DXC's portfolio to solve critical business challenges.

If you have an established Automotive network, thrive on developing new business, and enjoy winning complex enterprise services opportunities, this role provides the opportunity to build a $10M+ business while partnering with one of the industry's broadest technology portfolios.

Location: Remote within Michigan (Detroit metropolitan area preferred). Candidates residing within 25 miles of a DXC office are required to work onsite a minimum of two days per week.

Travel: Up to 50% to support client meetings and business engagements.

Role Overview: As a Sales Manager – Automotive & Manufacturing Industry, you will drive growth of DXC's Business & IT Services portfolio within the Automotive and Manufacturing sector. Your primary focus will be acquiring new logos and expanding into new buying centers within existing accounts across traditional and emerging OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.

Key Responsibilities
- Acquire new logos and expand existing Automotive and Manufacturing accounts.
- Build and manage a qualified pipeline with 3x+ quota coverage.
- Develop opportunities through executive relationships and consultative selling.
- Lead discovery sessions and align client challenges with DXC solutions.
- Partner with presales, delivery, and alliance teams to develop proposals and close complex opportunities.
- Maintain forecast accuracy, CRM discipline, and pipeline health.
- Lead negotiations and drive opportunities to successful close.

Core DXC Solution Areas
- AI-Led Innovation
- Application Modernization
- Business Transformation
- Enterprise Platforms (SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Boomi)
- Alliance-Led Selling

Quota / Scope
- Annual Quota: $10M+
- Primary Metric: Net-new bookings

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
- 6–8 years of enterprise technology or IT services sales within Automotive and/or Manufacturing.
- Proven success exceeding quota in a hunter sales role.
- Strong knowledge of Automotive OEMs, Tier 1/Tier 2 suppliers, and mobility organizations.
- Established executive network within the Michigan/Midwest Automotive market.
- Experience selling AI, Application Modernization, Business Transformation, or Enterprise Platform solutions.
- Strong consultative selling and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting Automotive digital transformation or ERP modernization.
- Familiarity with Industry 4.0, software-defined vehicles, and connected enterprise.
- Experience co-selling with SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or Boomi.
- Previous experience with a Global Systems Integrator (GSI) or large IT services organization.

Core Skills & Attributes
- Hunter mentality with a passion for new business development.
- Executive communication and presentation skills.
- Consultative selling and complex deal management.
- Strong forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM discipline.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship

A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $109,600 - $164,400.

Location: Remote (with travel to client sites as needed); While this is a remote role, if you reside within 25 miles of a DXC local office, you will be required to work onsite at least 2 days per week.

Role Overview:  As a Sales Manager – Dynatrace, you will drive growth of DXC’s Dynatrace-based observability offerings by qualifying opportunities, progressing pipeline, and closing services and solutions engagements. You’ll partner closely with account teams, solutioning/presales, and Dynatrace counterparts to create value-based proposals aligned to client outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
- Own sales execution for DXC’s Dynatrace offerings: qualify, pursue, and close opportunities across existing accounts and selected new-logo targets
- Build and manage a healthy pipeline by identifying, progressing, and appropriately disqualifying opportunities using clear qualification criteria
- Lead discovery and position business value by translating observability use cases into measurable outcomes (resilience, performance, cost optimization, automation)
- Collaborate with Dynatrace and DXC teams on joint account planning, campaigns, and co-selling motions
- Coordinate stakeholders (presales, delivery, product, partner/alliance teams) to shape solutions, develop proposals, and drive deal velocity
- Build relationships with customer stakeholders (IT and business leaders) to understand priorities and align solutions to the customer’s technology strategy
- Maintain forecast accuracy and sales hygiene (CRM updates, deal reviews, close plans, and risk mitigation)

Quota / Scope
- Manage and deliver against an annual quota typically in the range of ~$5M–$25M (varies by territory and assigned accounts)

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
- 3+ years of enterprise technology sales and/or sales support experience
- Exposure to observability/APM solutions; Dynatrace familiarity is a strong plus
- Experience with consultative, outcome-led selling (discovery → value proposition → solution shaping → close)
- Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and drive opportunities forward

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience selling services/solutions in managed services, cloud operations, application operations, SRE/IT operations, or automation
- Experience co-selling with partners and alliance teams (Dynatrace field, channel, or GSI motions)
- Familiarity with customer buying centers across IT Ops, App teams, Platform Engineering, Security, and Digital leaders

Core Skills & Attributes
- Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
- Ability to run structured discovery and articulate business/technical value clearly
- Negotiation and deal orchestration skills; comfortable coordinating multiple teams
- Strong pipeline discipline, forecasting, and CRM hygiene

Work Environment / Eligibility
- Remote role with travel as needed
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future

As a Senior Sales Manager – Oracle, you will lead growth for DXC’s Oracle portfolio across large, complex enterprise accounts, including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Oracle SaaS applications (ERP, HCM, SCM), and Oracle modernization and managed services. - Lead executive‑level discovery sessions, translating Oracle use cases (ERP/HCM/SCM transformation, OCI migration, data modernization, managed services) into measurable business and financial outcomes

- Experience selling large‑scale enterprise services in cloud transformation, application modernization, managed services, or digital transformation
- Proven success co‑selling with Oracle field leadership, channel partners, or global system integrators (GSI motions)
- Deep familiarity with enterprise buying centers across Finance, HR, Supply Chain, and IT (Applications, Infrastructure, Architecture, Security, Cloud Operations)

- Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder influence skills
- Ability to articulate business value, financial impact, and technical strategy clearly and credibly
- Advanced negotiation, deal orchestration, and complex sales leadership capabilities

- You will own Aerospace and Defense growth. That includes pipeline, bookings, and revenue. You will build the strategy and execute it, expanding DXC’s presence across aerospace OEMs, defense primes, Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, and the broader ecosystem that supports them.
- You will lead large, complex initiatives across digital engineering, application modernization, data and AI, cloud transformation, and enterprise platforms. You will be involved from qualification through the win strategy, proposal, negotiation, and close.
- After the deal closes, you will stay engaged to ensure a smooth transition to delivery and continued account growth.
- On the Federal and Public Sector side, you will apply your experience working in regulated environments. If you have worked on IDIQs, task orders, or long-cycle pursuits, you will understand how to navigate this environment and position DXC for success.
- You will build executive relationships with clients and partners. Not surface-level relationships, but trusted relationships where clients involve you early in their planning and transformation initiatives. You will also work closely with hyperscalers, software partners, and Aerospace and Defense ecosystem partners to build differentiated solutions.
- You will maintain strong pipeline discipline, accurate forecasting, and clear win strategies aligned to DXC growth priorities.

​
What You Are Selling
You will sell large-scale digital transformation programs, including consulting, enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft Dynamics, application modernization, digital engineering, cloud and platform transformation, cybersecurity, and Data and AI solutions, supported by DXC’s global consulting, engineering, and delivery organization.

This is not a point solution sales role. This role focuses on enterprise transformation programs and multi-year-old services engagements.

What You Bring
- 10 or more years of enterprise sales experience with a strong focus on Aerospace and Defense
- Proven track record growing Aerospace and Defense accounts and closing complex multi-year services and transformation deals
- Experience selling digital engineering, cloud, data, cybersecurity, or other mission-critical technology solutions
- Strong understanding of how Aerospace and Defense organizations buy, including program structures, buying centers, capture processes, and long-cycle sales motions
- Experience working with U.S. Federal, Department of Defense, or defense-related clients
- Familiarity with regulated environments, including ITAR, export controls, and secure delivery requirements
- Experience supporting programs that require security clearances
- Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, IDIQs, GWACs, and capture methodology
- Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, technology, or equivalent experience
- Additional qualifications that are valued
- MBA, MS, or formal pursuit training such as Shipley, TAS, or Miller Heiman
- Experience working with defense primes, aerospace OEMs, or federal system integrators
- Experience leading large capture pursuits and complex proposal efforts
- Experience partnering with hyperscalers or enterprise software providers on joint pursuits

At DXC we use the power of technology to deliver mission-critical IT services that our customers need to modernize operations and drive innovation across their entire IT estate. We provide services across the Enterprise Technology Stack for business process outsourcing, analytics and engineering, applications, security, cloud, IT outsourcing, and modern workplace.
People in Corporate Functions make DXC a well-run and high-functioning organization. Each team contributes to DXC's success, and everyone delivers world-class service and has opportunities to grow and learn.

About This Role:
DXC is looking for a Consulting Engineering Sales Lead to join our growing LATAM Sales team by driving the sales process and outcomes on a dedicated basis, building, growing a profitable pipeline and or backlog of sales, through deal origination, sales negotiations, and closure.
The Consulting Engineering Sales Lead for Mexico Region will be responsible for driving business growth through technical consulting and solution selling. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic sales leadership to position the company’s solutions effectively across diverse industries in the region. The ideal candidate will act as a trusted advisor to clients, ensuring alignment between technical solutions and business objectives and leading Mexico´s consulting engineering sales team.

What You´ll Do:
- Lead complex selling efforts that identify, qualify, cultivate, and close new business in Consulting Engineering Service (CES) in Mexico Region

- Maintain accurate and timely customer, pipeline and forecast data working with Sales Operations

- Create and help frame DXC’s differentiated value story, develop strategic win themes for proposals

- Drive joint opportunities and source partner pipeline

- Operate within large teams and directs specific team sales origination activities

- Create strategic and tactical plans to grow a book of business and assist in closing opportunities

- Educate Clients on DXC capabilities and success stories to effectively communicate DXC’ value prop to both partners and customers

- Interact with senior management levels at clients and within DXC

- Foster relationships, both with clients and internally with account teams

- Sales Leadership:

-Develop and execute a regional sales strategy focused on consulting engineering   services.
-Identify and pursue new business opportunities within Mexico.
-Achieve or exceed revenue targets and growth objectives.
- Technical Consulting:

-Provide technical guidance and solution design for clients in collaboration with engineering teams
-Lead pre-sales activities, including presentations, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept engagements.
-Translate complex technical requirements into clear business value propositions.
- Client Relationship Management:

-Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level    executives and technical decision-makers.
-Act as the primary point of contact for consulting engineering engagements.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Role Purpose
The Business Development Executive (BDE) is responsible for originating, shaping, and qualifying new business opportunities, with a primary focus on new logos and net‑new material scope.
The role operates at the front end of the deal lifecycle, engaging C‑suite and senior decision‑makers to uncover transformational business opportunities and translate them into qualified, high‑value proposals and signed contracts.
The role exists to create high‑quality demand , shape sizeable opportunities , and drive material growth by converting executive conversations into qualified deals, proposals and signed contracts.

Responsibilities
Market Engagement & Opportunity Origination
- Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities through executive relationships, industry engagement, networking, direct outreach, and strategic market activity

- Build trusted relationships with CxO‑level and senior decision‑makers to understand strategic priorities, business challenges, and transformation agendas

- Position the company’s endtoend value proposition in a compelling, business outcome oriented manner

Deal Shaping & Qualification
- Lead early stage opportunity qualification , including:
- Strategic fit

- Deal economics

- Competitive positioning

- Client decision structure and buying intent

- Drive deal shaping activities before formal sales engagement , ensuring opportunities are:
- Material in size

- Executable

- Aligned to client value and company growth priorities

- Decide, in collaboration with leadership, whether opportunities should be pursued, refined, disqualified, or transitioned

Experience Requirements
- Strong background in Business Development , with a focus on new sales and new logo acquisition

- Proven experience engaging with C‑suite, board‑level, and senior enterprise stakeholders

- Industry experience with the ability to adapt messaging and value propositions

- Demonstrated capability in strategic thinking, deal shaping, and roadmap planning for complex organizations

ポジションの目的   Role Purpose

ビジネスデベロップメントエグゼクティブ（BDE） は、新規顧客（New Logo）の獲得と新規大型案件の創出に特化した、新規ビジネス機会の発掘・形成・山筋を主要な役割とするポジションです。
このポジションは、ディールライフサイクル（商話展開から契約締結までのプロセス）の最前線を担当し、Cスイート（Cレベル経営層）およびシニア意思決定者へのアプローチを通じて、トランスフォーメーションの機会を発掘し、高付加価値の提案・契約締結へとつなげます。
本ポジションの存在意義： 質の高い商話機会（デマンド）を創出し、大型案件を形成し、経営層との対話を具体的な案件・提案・契約へと変換することで、事業の実質的な成長を実現することです。

主な職務内容   Responsibilities

マーケットエンゲージメント＆案件創出
（ Market Engagement & Opportunity Origination）
●  エグゼクティブリレーション（経営層との人脈）、業界ネットワーキング、ダイレクトアウトリーチ（直接アプローチ）、戦略的な市場活動を通じて、新規ビジネス機会を能動的に発掘・開拓する
●  CxO（経営層）およびシニア意思決定者との信頼関係を構築し、戦略的優先事項・ビジネス課題・トランスフォーメーション計画（アジェンダ）を深く理解する
●  自社のエンドツーエンドのバリュープロポジション（価値提案）を、ビジネス成果志向で魅力的に訴求する

ディールシェーピング＆クオリフィケーション
（ Deal Shaping & Qualification）
●  案件の初期段階におけるクオリフィケーション（適格性評価）を主導する：
–  戦略的適合性（Strategic Fit）：自社战略との整合性
–  ディールエコノミクス（Deal Economics）：案件の経済合理性
–  競合ポジショニング（Competitive Positioning）：市場における位置づけ
–  クライアントの意思決定構造と購買意向（Buying Intent）の分析
●  正式な営業プロセスに入る前に、ディールシェーピング（案件形成）活動を推進し、以下を確認する：
–  十分な規模感があるか（Material in Size）
–  実行可能か（Executable）
–  クライアント価値および自社の成長戦略と合致しているか
●  リーダーシップと連携し、案件の追求・精査・不適格判定（Disqualification）・他チームへの移管を判断する

経験要件   Experience Requirements
●  ビジネス開発（Business Development）の豊富な経験を持ち、新規営業および新規顧客（ニューロゴ）獲得に注力した実績を持つ方
●  Cスイート（経営層）・取締役レベル・シニアエンタープライズステークホルダーとの実蹏あるエンゲージメント経験
●  業界知識を活かし、メッセージングやバリュープロポジション（価値提案）を柔軟にアダプトできる能力
●  複雑な組織に対する戦略的思考力、ディールシェーピング（案件形成）、ロードマップ策定の実証された能力

このポジションの魅力   Why This Role

ディールライフサイクルの最前線で案件を「WIN」に導く
単なる営業ではなく、「ゼロからイチ」で大型案件を創り出すダイナミックな役割。商話引きのディールメーカーとしての問題解決力と创造力を発揮できます。

Cレベル経営層と直接対話し、ビジネス変革を投貨できる
大企業の経営層と双方対等に議論し、トランスフォーメーションのビジネスアウトカム（成果）を共に答を出すことができる强インパクトなポジション。

新規顧客開拓に特化した明確な役割分担
既存顧客対応ではなく、新規市場・新規顧客の開拓という「攻めの営業」に徹底特化。ハンターマインドを持つプロフェッショナルが活躍できる環境です。

戦略的思考力とリレーションシップ構築力を最大限に発揮できる
DXCのグローバルネットワークと日本市場の知見を活かし、戦略立案から契約締結まで自己裁量を持って案件を進められる自律的なポジションです。

DXC テクノロジーでは、コミュニティの強いつながりが成功への鍵であると考えています。 DXC のワークモデルは、対面でのコラボレーションを重視しつつ、社員の幸福度、生産性、個々の働き方、そして生活環境をサポートする柔軟性も提供しています。 DXC は、誰もが活躍できるインクルーシブな環境づくりに尽力しています。

採用詐欺とは、架空の求人情報を求職者に提供する詐欺行為であり、通常は偽のウェブサイトや、企業を装った未承諾のメールなどのオンラインサービスを通じて行われます。これらのメールは、受信者に個人情報の提供や、違法な採用プロセスの一環として支払いを求めることがあります。DXCでは、ソーシャルメディアネットワークを通じて雇用のオファーを行うことはなく、採用プロセスのいかなる段階でも応募者に金銭や支払いを求めることはありません。また、求職者にIT機器やその他の設備の購入を当社の代理として依頼することもありません。採用詐欺に関する詳細は こちら をご覧ください 。
